Exact source-specific defect and required correction: Actual returned fullsize image invents a dense moustache AND pointed chin goatee. The actual original adviser card, also confirmed against its visually matching large Asia generic land 1 source, is CLEAN-SHAVEN. Remove all upper-lip and chin hair, keep skin areas smooth yellow. Preserve short side-parted black scalp hair, eyebrows, original thin GOLD subtly rounded RECTANGULAR spectacle frames (not large round frames), and olive CLOSED tunic with original red collar tabs, buttons and pose.
Final check: restore exactly the stated original accessories/facial hair in the stated extent and color; no invented additional hair or human skin/ears. Keep every already correct card and clothing detail.
Output alpha: keep a genuine fully transparent RGBA background outside the portrait silhouette. No painted gray backdrop, halo, studio gradient or rectangular plate. Retain the source's clothing, hair, headgear and portrait crop.
Additional source-fidelity check: ONLY IF the original has a moustache, make it a DISTINCT visible textured band of fine painted hair ABOVE the mascot reference existing grey lip/small mouth, with a narrow strip of yellow separating hair and mouth. The mascot normal grey lip wedge and its shading are NOT a moustache; do not merely recolor that lip. Keep clean-shaven sources bare. Preserve the source visible collar-patch symbol count and arrangement; no invented medallions. Illegible original note markings must remain indistinct texture, no new readable serial numbers, identification codes or words.
